sources.label: PD 1096, Rule XII, Section 1211 — Chimneys and Fireplaces (2004 Revised IRR)
sources.description: Governing code for chimney and fireplace construction in the Philippines. Covers wall thickness by heat load, anchorage, lining requirements, clearances to combustibles, and height requirements.

sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004, Rule XII, Sec. 1211.1 — Structural Requirements and Anchorage
sources.description: Chimneys must be designed, anchored, supported, and reinforced. Lateral anchoring required at ceiling line and every floor line more than 1.80m above grade in wood-frame buildings.

sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004, Rule XII, Sec. 1211.2 — Fireplaces and Hearths
sources.description: Fireplace outer wall: 200mm min. Firebox wall: 250mm (200mm with firebrick lining). Firebox depth: 500mm min. Hearth front extension: 450mm min. Hearth side extension: 300mm min. Hearth slab thickness: 100mm.

sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004, Rule XII, Sec. 1211.4 — Corbeling Rules
sources.description: Maximum total corbel projection: 150mm. Minimum wall thickness for corbeling: 300mm. Maximum projection per course: 25mm. Two-storey Group A exception for second storey.

sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004, Rule XII, Sec. 1211.1.e — Chimney Height Requirements
sources.description: Dual-condition height rule: Chimney must terminate at least 600mm above roof penetration AND at least 600mm above highest building part within 3.00m.

sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004, Rule XII, Sec. 1211.1.b — Medium Heat Appliance Lining Threshold
sources.description: Firebrick lining >=100mm required for medium heat appliances, starting 600mm below connector. If chimney <=7.50m above connector, lining extends to top.
